boundary: This ecology relates exact recurrent textual faces. It does not yet relate nonidentical contexts by a cultivated shared constituent, grammatical transformation, consequence in another world, or other cross-face topology. Exact suffix restriction is not approximate similarity. The tokenizer is a lawful reversible source boundary, not a vocabulary oracle. The report observes a bounded corpus cut and does not claim corpus-scale language closure.
capability: A raw child-directed text stream now cultivates its own reversible token grains, relative chronological addresses, recurrent suffix receivers, exact continuation populations, and complete COPY/FOUND paths. A receiver may carry one continuation, several locally afforded continuations, or a residual outside its present field. Receiving that residual as a genuinely later utterance changes the field; source reversal changes it as well.
question: Can bounded ordinary chronological UTF-8 cultivate exact local continuation fields, preserve plural consequences and complete causal paths, return an unseen consequence as residual, and let that later consequence change the same ecology?
stopping_condition: Stop after the frozen real-text cut yields complete representative recurrent-single, recurrent-plural, recurrent-copy, multi-token, unseen-consequence, and shorter-recurrent-cut fields; exact rest/remount; a chronology-reversal foil; and the changed field after the held-out residual actually enters as later current. Refuse rather than truncate any causal path.

validation_census.selection_law: first validation event in each qualitative relation class, plus the first COPY-bearing path, the first multi-token recurrent cut, and the first shorter exact restriction; every selected context has horizon >= 1 and its complete path field fits the declared observer aperture; observation does not alter the ecology
